description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.name: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore
uses.cardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night
